summary: V4-06 — À faire (Tâche ou Dépense) is fully implemented and verified. The TodosScreen now supports creating typed todo items (task/expense), completing them with confirmed fields (performer/value/beneficiaries for tasks; payer/amount/currency/participants for expenses), equal/custom splits, optional notes and photos, and atomic offline-safe completion via completeTodoAtomic. All 619 tests pass including 14 dedicated V4-06 tests covering screen wiring, i18n, typed creation, exact-one-entry completion, and failure-injection atomicity. No regressions in V4-01 through V4-05 or V3 foundations. Trusted verification exit code 0.
